macros.name: envirsep
macros.doc: \envirsep is inserted between the environments that are typeset, and is set to \par by default.

macros.name: nofloat
macros.doc: \nofloat disables floating, and \vfill is inserted forcefully on each side of each float.

macros.name: rescanfile
macros.doc: \rescanfile{} suppresses the creation of a temporary file; the leftover text is simply discarded.

macros.name: xcommentchar
macros.doc: You can change the command character by redefining \xcommentchar .

envs.name: xcomment
envs.doc: Within the xcomment environment, only text within each of the specified environments is typeset.
